pythonFunction.name: get_stop_eligibility
pythonFunction.description:
Says whether the account can stop service online. An account in collections or with a shutoff
notice is not eligible and goes to a representative. Needs an identified caller. Before calling
this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the identified account (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, eligible and reason.
